Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly narrowed the scope from the University of Mississippi (where Khayat was educated) to its law school, introducing Cleve McDowell as the first Black student at Ole Miss Law (1963). This scope drift conflated a sub-school milestone with the university-wide milestone, leading away from the correct answer (James Meredith, 1962) for the institution as a whole.
